items.title: INV-013 E-ladder REALISED timescale-separation probe: does E1/E2/E3 own-state autocorrelation show the designed 1:3:10 monotonic ordering, or does it collapse like MECH-058 did
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC PROBE, route (c) per GOV-REUSE-1 Step 2.4: decisive readout = per-loop (E1/E2/E3 own-state) lag-k autocorrelation half-life at env-step resolution. Checked v3_exq_827a_inv091 (band/phase-sync prior art, same architecture region) -- aggregate stats only, no raw per-step traces persisted anywhere; checked v3_exq_627 similarly, same pattern. Only partial prior art: claim_probe_mech_058/runs/20260317T232028Z_v3_exq_019_timescale_v3_v3 (MECH-058, retired) measured z_self/z_world lag-k autocorrelation directly but (a) no E3 signal at all, (b) RANDOM actions (E3 selection never exercised), (c) failed its own C4 n_steps>=3000 (n=969, seed=0 only), (d) predates the 2026-07-12 Recording Standard (no substrate_hash, unverifiable-substrate reuse per the pre-standard caveat). NOT recoverable by reanalysis for the E3 leg -> run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): INV-013 count=0 (recomputed at queue time), not braked. Substrate-path overlap (Step 2.5c): q081_profile_kwargs() sets use_salience_coordinator=True by default, which would have exercised the OPEN mode-governance-engagement substrate_queue entry (severity=corrupting, covers ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py + ree_core/agent.py) -- this probe never reads operating_mode, so the flag is explicitly reset to False (REEConfig default) in _build_cfg, removing the overlap rather than running under the limitation. Four DEGRADING open entries remain in the executed footprint (run proceeds under them, noted per the rule): SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (e3_selector.py untrained fallback scorer subnetworks -- not read by this probe, which only reads get_commitment_state()), mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (causal_grid_world.py, onboarding-specific, not exercised by this env config), SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action norm-vs-benefit scale mismatch in a defensive-orienting override branch this probe does not trigger), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (contextual-safety threshold sourcing, not read by this probe). THREE STRUCTURAL FINDINGS established by source-reading (see script docstring for citations), independent of run outcome: (1) ticks["e2_tick"] is computed by MultiRateClock.advance() but never consumed anywhere in ree_core/ -- dead code; (2) experiments/_lib/stream_recorder.py documents (2026-07-26 finding) the entire LatentStack (z_self/z_world/z_beta/z_theta/z_delta/z_harm/z_harm_a, including ARC-004's own L-space layers) is re-encoded every env step regardless of loop identity; (3) E3's own precision/running_variance are also mutated every env tick (update_running_variance via post_action_update, not gated to e3_tick) -- only commit_threshold and is_committed are genuinely E3-cadence. PASS/FAIL criterion reuses ARC-004's own pre-registered wording (monotonic tau_e1<tau_e2<tau_e3 by >=0.8 SD of the cross-seed half-life delta), applied to the E-loops instead of L-space layers. SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings. Tiny 2-episode dry-run: correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (n=40 < 3000 floor), z_goal_stream wired (goal_state_present=True, no writer defect), all progress-instrumentation lines present. Larger single-seed smoke (5 warmup / 21 eval episodes, outside the production episode counts): n_steps_total=2950 (just under the 3000 floor with only 5 warmup episodes vs the production 40 -- correctly self-routes not-ready; production settings give ~4-5x the warmup and eval budget). _monotonic_verdict/_halflife/_run_length_stats/_compute_autocorr unit-tested directly against synthetic monotonic and non-monotonic per-seed data, both branches correct. OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED -- STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMED: queued from ree-cloud-5 (headless metaworker box), which has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env, so POST /queue/add could not be issued. This entry is durably on origin/main but UNRUNNABLE by the fleet until a coordinator-capable box (the Mac) POSTs it from this commit. Does not promote/demote INV-013, ARC-004, or SD-006 -- that is a /governance decision from this evidence.
